title: Brian Hobson Karate Studio

services.name: Brian Hobson Karate Studios
services.desc: Brian Hobson Karate is the best studio in Hampton roads! Brian and all his excellently trained instructors are committed to authentic Japanese teaching. The kids flourish and excel under Brian's direction...and have fun while doing it. We have been with Brian Hobson 4+ years and it is amazing to see children begin with no skill -and often times very shy; after one (1) month you can see drastic contrast! The children are confident, respectful and practicing karate moves like champs! I also love the encouragement every child receives from all instructors. There is a dedication to discipline and respect that is so refreshing yet unique in 2018! I Highly recommend this studio and truly believe
